title: W1 fix is inert in a real browser: the review submit's _focus_seconds is never populated, so focus_seconds_reported stays 0 (still present since r1)
evidence:
reference_form.js:152-153 "      var section = form.closest(".ref-question");
      if (!section) return;"
reference_form.js:157-158 "      var focusField = form.querySelector("[data-focus-seconds]");
      if (focusField) focusField.value = currentFocusSeconds();"
reference_form.js:70 "    var page = doc.querySelector("[data-testid='reference-form-page']");"
reference_form.js:80 "    if (questions.length === 0) return;"
form_pages.gleam:236-242 "            html.input([
              attribute.type_("hidden"),
              attribute.name("_focus_seconds"),
              attribute.value("0"),
              attribute("data-focus-seconds", ""),
            ]),"
detail: Only the .ref-question submit interceptor fills data-focus-seconds; view_review (testid reference-review, no reference-form-page wrapper) has no .ref-question sections, so initBrowser bails and the review POST always sends the hardcoded "0". The crafted-POST tests pin plumbing, not browser behavior.
recommended_fix: In reference_form.js, set [data-focus-seconds] on the review form's submit (listener on [data-testid='reference-review-form'] that fills the value without preventDefault, hoisting the focus accumulator above the .ref-question bail) and add a node test.

title: N3 objected-routing branch matches the raw row.status string literal instead of the typed status_from_string parser classify_row uses in the same file
detail: Functionally safe (the Declined arm admits only refused/objected, so the _ fallback is correct), but the branch re-opens the raw DB string after classify_row already parsed it, adding a second, untyped status-to-view mapping beside the typed parser used at line 1444.
recommended_fix: Match reference_call.status_from_string(row.status) { Objected -> view_objected; _ -> view_declined } — identical behavior through one typed status mapping; future statuses added to the Declined arm resolve via the same parser.
